messages:
Aria (PM): quick heads-up 1: we're iterating on the first-run experience. proposing a lean '3-choice' entry with a persistent 'Show all' link instead of a big list. want quick takes.
Diego (Design): thumbs up for less visual clutter. current mock has 4 columns on wide screens which reads like a catalog. 3 cards centered feels calmer.
Nina (DevEx): +1 but please keep a clear path for users who need dedicated/private environments. maybe a small 'Advanced options' affordance.
Ravi (Eng): implementation note: we can collapse extras into a modal. effort: front-end change + prefill endpoint adjustment. also need to emit which variation user saw for AB test.
Aria (PM): AB test plan idea: variant A = 3 cards + 'Show all' modal, variant B = single focused card + right-side mini-checklist. Metric: conversion to "complete onboarding checklist" within 24h.
Priya (A11y): a few accessibility nits from the early mock: card titles don't have semantic headings, screen reader users may not perceive card grouping. recommend `role=group` and `aria-labelledby` on each card.
Diego (Design): noted. will change card titles to H3 semantics and add visually-hidden descriptions for screen readers. also reducing copy density: benefit line max 18 words.
Nina (DevEx): UX copy ask: CTA currently 'Use preset' — feels passive. alternatives: 'Start with this', 'Try this setup'. prefer action-forward.
Ravi (Eng): prefer 'Start with this' for consistency with other flows. telemetry: we'll add `onboard_preset_chosen` with fields: preset_key, variant, user_id. also capture `preset_discover_more` when they open the modal.
Aria (PM): what about adding micro samples under each card, like one-line config blurbs? e.g., "Small model, KV cache on, batch 8". keeps expectations correct.
Diego (Design): happy to include a 1-line config blurb (mono font) collapsed into a hover/expand. On mobile, expansions should be full-screen sheet.
Priya (A11y): keyboard focus: ensure the entire card is clickable with Enter/Space and that focus ring is 4px and meets 3:1 contrast. also announce when modal opens: `role=dialog` and set focus to first heading.
Nina (DevEx): small copy tweak: hero CTA currently says 'Create project' but onboarding creates a 'workspace' containing samples. suggest 'Create workspace' and secondary text 'Includes sample app, prompts, and cost estimate'.
Ravi (Eng): backend mapping: choosing a preset triggers `POST /api/onboard/prefill` with payload `preset_id, variant_id, user_id`. default prefill sets model, batch, kv_cache flags.
Aria (PM): can we add a tiny '?' tooltip on each preset labeled 'Why this?' that shows 1-sentence tradeoffs? keeps card clean while surfacing reasoning.
Diego (Design): yes. will design tooltip with 12px text, 2-line max. will also add a 'Customize' link that opens advanced modal where users can tweak GPU/quant settings.
Priya (A11y): for the tooltip, ensure it's keyboard accessible and uses `aria-describedby` on the card. use a short id for the tooltip content.
Nina (DevEx): request: track whether users click 'Customize' after selecting a preset. that will help prioritize defaults.
Ravi (Eng): will add event `preset_customize_clicked`. also will include `variant_id` in all events (values: 'cards_3' or 'focused_rail').
Aria (PM): timeline: folks ok to ship behind flag next week? collect metrics for 2 weeks then decide default.
Diego (Design): can have mocks + responsive specs by EOD tomorrow.
Priya (A11y): I'll run a quick checklist on both designs and post issues. main areas: headings, keyboard flow, dialog semantics, contrast.
Nina (DevEx): thanks team. also let's surface a subtle 'skip onboarding' link so experienced users can jump straight in.
OnboardBot: preview build for `onboard/lean-presets` is deployed at https://preview.redwood-inference/onboard-2089 :white_check_mark:
Ravi (Eng): perfect. I'll wire telemetry and prefills. ping me if mocks include new metadata fields.
Aria (PM): thanks all. leaving this thread open for any last-minute copy or accessibility notes.
